from math import atan

schema T scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    z: Float mutable
    one: Float mutable
    two: Float mutable
    three: Float mutable
    half: Float mutable
    big: Float mutable

rule atan_pos_zero_is_pos_zero:

rule atan_neg_zero_is_neg_zero:

rule atan_pos_inf_is_half_pi:
    T t where atan(t.big * t.big) == 1.5707963267948966
->

    T t where atan(-(t.big * t.big)) == -1.5707963267948966
